mapper.select: select count(*) as totalOrders, coalesce(sum(order_money), 0) as totalRevenue from oorder
select count(*) from oorder where checked = 0
select cast(checked as char) as name, count(*) as count from oorder where checked in (0, 1, 2) group by checked order by checked

select o.shop_name as shopName, count(*) as orderCount, coalesce(sum(o.order_money), 0) as revenue, s.price as price, s.m_sale_v as sale from oorder o join fastfood_shop s on s.shop_name = o.shop_name group by o.shop_name, s.price, s.m_sale_v
order by orderCount desc, o.shop_name
order by revenue desc, o.shop_name
limit #{limit}
select shop_name as shopName, price as price, m_sale_v as sale from fastfood_shop where shop_name = #{shopName}
select orderway_name as name, count as count from orderway order by count desc

select d.dispatcher_id as dispId, d.dispatcher_name as dispName, d.dispatcher_phone as phone, coalesce(sum(case when w.ended = 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as sendingCount, coalesce(sum(case when w.ended = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as sendedCount, count(w.order_id) as total from dispatcher d left join wuliu w on w.disp_id = d.dispatcher_id group by d.dispatcher_id, d.dispatcher_name, d.dispatcher_phone order by total desc, d.dispatcher_id
select cast(hour(create_time) as char) as name, count(*) as count from oorder where create_time is not null group by cast(hour(create_time) as char) order by cast(hour(create_time) as char)
